result.question: Why did God allow Shechem's treachery?

readings.answer: To bring the crime against Jerubbaal’s seventy sons to justice
readings.support: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice

readings.answer: To avenge their blood on Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem
readings.support: and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem
